title: Senior/Principal Consultant SAP Security & Berechtigungen (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben Diese Aufgaben erwarten Dich:
 Du konzipierst, implementierst und optimierst SAP Berechtigungskonzepte – sowohl On-Premise als auch in Cloud-Umgebungen. Du berätst Kunden zu SAP Security- und Compliance-Themen, inklusive Governance, Risk & Compliance. Du führst Kundengespräche, Workshops und Presales-Termine eigenständig durch – von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zur Lösungspräsentation. Du unterstützt bei Audits und analysierst sowie optimierst bestehende Berechtigungslandschaften. Du arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung interner Best Practices und Security-Standards mit.
 Dein Profil Das bringst du mit: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich SAP Berechtigungen bzw. SAP Authorization Management. Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP Security, Identity & Access Management (IAM) und Segregation of Duties (SoD). Du bringst Erfahrung oder gute Kenntnisse in SAP GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) mit. Du kennst dich im Design und in der Implementierung von Berechtigungskonzepten sowie in der Rollen- und Benutzerverwaltung aus. Du hast Erfahrung mit Compliance-Anforderungen, Audit-Unterstützung und Risikobewertung. Du trittst beim Kunden sicher und professionell auf und kannst Kunden- und Presales-Gespräche eigenständig führen. Du kommunizierst klar, präsentierst überzeugend und arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert. Nice to have, wenn du außerdem Folgendes mitbringst: Erfahrung mit Xiting-Tools, insbesondere XAMS. Grundkenntnisse im Bereich SAP Basis. Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA-Transformationen. Zertifizierungen im Bereich SAP Security oder SAP GRC. Erfahrung in internationalen Projekten oder mit Cloud-Security, zum Beispiel SAP BTP.

title: Office Coordinator (Working Student)
description:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.
Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 We are looking for an energetic, organized, and proactive Working Student - Office Coordinator to become the heartbeat of our Berlin workspace. In this role, you will be the driving force behind a smooth, welcoming, and highly efficient daily office environment. Balancing 20 hours a week around your studies (3 days per week) you will manage day-to-day office operations, support our team, and help cultivate a vibrant workplace culture. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on operational and administrative experience in a fast-paced, international business environment.

 Office Operations & Hospitality
 Workspace Management: Act as the main point of contact for the Berlin office, ensuring the workspace remains professional, organized, welcoming, and tidy at all times.

title: Software Engineer II, Foundation
description:
Platform Engineering at Chainalysis provides the shared infrastructure, tooling, and developer experience layer that powers every engineering team. We are moving away from team-owned infrastructure silos and consolidating onto shared, scalable platform patterns. The Foundation discipline owns the substrate: cloud infrastructure, networking, Kubernetes, streaming, and security primitives. Everything else runs on what we build.
 We are hiring a Software Engineer II to join the Foundation team. Your job is straightforward: build, improve, and operate the infrastructure primitives that every service at Chainalysis depends on — Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, streaming infrastructure (Kafka / WarpStream), secrets management, IAM, and the reconcilers that make it all self-service and drift-free. This is an infrastructure-focused IC role at the C4 level, typically suited for someone with 3–5 years of experience. You will work alongside senior engineers who will pair with you, review your work, and invest in your growth. You will report to the Senior Manager of Platform Engineering.
 In this role, you'll:
 Build and maintain cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP using Terraform — designing the modules and patterns that provision the substrate our services run on, and thinking beyond the immediate use case to how your work is consumed across the organization
 Operate and evolve multi-tenant Kubernetes clusters (EKS) serving the entire engineering organization — owning node lifecycle, upgrades, security contexts, and networking decisions that affect every team
 Own the operational side of our streaming infrastructure migration from managed Kafka (MSK) to WarpStream, building and maintaining the tooling that supports it
